widget.title: Kubernetes Container - Restart count for SDE
Kubernetes Container - Restart count for SDE

time_series_query.time_series_query_language:
fetch k8s_container
| metric 'kubernetes.io/container/restart_count'
| filter (resource.namespace_name == 'sde')
| align delta(5m)
| every 5m
| filter value.restart_count != 0
| filter has_value(value.restart_count) = true()

widget.title: Kubernetes Container - Restart count for SDE

time_series_query.time_series_query_language:
fetch k8s_pod
| metric 'logging.googleapis.com/log_entry_count'
| filter
    (metric.log == 'events'
     && metric.severity =~ 'WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL|ALERT|EMERGENCY')
| align delta(1m)
| every 1m
| group_by [resource.pod_name],
    [value_log_entry_count_aggregate: aggregate(value.log_entry_count)]

widget.title: Volume Creation Error - Data LIF Error

time_series_query.time_series_query_language:
{ t_0:
    fetch gce_instance
    | metric 'compute.googleapis.com/guest/system/problem_count'
    | filter (metric.reason == 'OOMKilling')
    | align delta(5m)
    | filter value.problem_count > 0
    | map add[node_name: metadata.system_labels.name]
    | group_by [node_name], [value_problem_count_sum: sum(value.problem_count)]
; t_1:
    fetch k8s_node
    | metric 'kubernetes.io/node/memory/used_bytes'
    | filter true()
    | filter true()
    | group_by 5m, [value_used_bytes_mean: mean(value.used_bytes)]
    | every 5m
    | map add[node_name: resource.node_name]
    | group_by [resource.cluster_name, node_name],
        [value_used_bytes_mean_aggregate: aggregate(value_used_bytes_mean)] }
| join
| value [t_0.value_problem_count_sum]

text.content:
Both Data Plane and Control Plane Versions in the below table should be the same and should be highest Versions

Detailed Steps:
https://confluence.ngage.netapp.com/display/COPS/How+to+-+troubleshooting+guide+for+service+mesh

time_series_query.prometheus_query: topk(50, avg by (node_name)(avg_over_time(kubernetes_io:node_memory_allocatable_utilization{monitored_resource="k8s_node", noop_filter=~".*", noop_filter=~".*", noop_filter=~".*"}[${__interval}]))) * 100

topk(50, avg by (node_name)(avg_over_time(kubernetes_io:node_cpu_allocatable_utilization{monitored_resource="k8s_node", noop_filter=~".*", noop_filter=~".*", noop_filter=~".*"}[${__interval}]))) * 100

avg by ("database_id","region")(avg_over_time({"__name__"="cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization","monitored_resource"="cloudsql_database"}[${__interval}])) > 0.9
